entries.text: When a run time limit is set, BenchBox warns on every cloud platform that work it started may keep running and billing, and says whether it can cancel that work. On a timeout, including the hard stop, Onehouse Quanton, BigQuery, EMR Serverless, AWS Glue and Dataproc now cancel the jobs and the application or cluster the run started; a failed cleanup is printed and does not change exit code 124. The cleanup has not been checked against live services.
